summary: Sandbach United secured an impressive 4-3 away victory at Market Drayton, with Kieran O'Connell netting a crucial brace including the winning goal, despite being reduced to 10 men when Niall Cope was sent off in the 71st minute. The Bach showed great resilience and character to fight back and claim all three points in an entertaining encounter. The squad will be looking to maintain this winning momentum in their upcoming fixtures.
